scope: Read-only CPU decode of two saved CONTROL PNGs and independent later raw FINAL readbacks. No TEST interpretation, GPU calls, source edits or same-frame qualification.
method: PNG IHDR/IDAT read with Python standard-library struct/zlib; 8-bit RGB/RGBA noninterlaced scanlines reconstructed using PNG filters 0-4. Each RGB triplet counted over the explicitly bounded top-right panel interior.

control_pack.interpretation: A downward water normal approximately (0,-1,0) encodes to approximately (0.5,0,0.5), dark purple rather than the bright (1,0,1) unknown warning. The bottom-right reflection diagnostic uses a separate expression and must not be mistaken for the normal panel.

panel_region.limits: Entire defined interior, not the whole 800x450 quadrant: the first panel column and final panel row are excluded. Warning counts apply only to this declared region.

coordinate_mapping.source: Parent FINAL q=fract(texcoord*2), p=ivec2(q*textureSize); raw texels use OpenGL lower-left coordinates.
coordinate_mapping.display_example: Raw texel (801,451) corresponds to an approximately doubled-quadrant top-right display pixel (1200,224) after PNG vertical inversion.
coordinate_mapping.qualification: Illustrative source-coordinate/normal-encoding comparison across separate times only. Equal 8-bit values do not prove frame identity or full-array equality.

timing_source_facts.recorder_camera_lock: Recorder.beforeWorldRender gates its lock to warmup/sampling; the lock is not active after completion.
timing_source_facts.screenshot_completion: Recorder.capture requests the framebuffer screenshot after saving measured pose/timings; completion waits for the screenshot callback/file before the run is marked complete.
timing_source_facts.raw_seam: ShoreRuntimeObserver.beforeFinalQuad independently captures later actual FINAL-bound inputs and exports its own UTC/frame/camera fields.
timing_source_facts.gap_limit: The exact values above are raw UTC minus run COMPLETE UTC, not exact screenshot-to-readback elapsed time. No PNG frame counter or capture frameTimeCounter is available, so an exact frame-index/time-counter difference cannot be established.

conclusion: The observed dark-purple normal panels are compatible with encoded downward normals and are not evidence of the bright unknown-alpha warning. No texture-routing or timing bug was established. Later selected raw C9 alpha=1 and matching camera positions remain independent observations, not same-frame PNG qualification.
